answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 9 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in lotus, checked in lantern, and mirror reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 3870 identities would post 3298 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
